result.title: Model reduction in time: Learning flow maps for reducing stochastic dynamical systems in time
result.summary: Predictions with dynamical systems can be computationally expensive---even with reduced models---because reaching future prediction times can require many sequential time integration steps. We propose Flow-Map First-Order Trajectory Matching (FM-FTM), a nonintrusive model reduction approach that accelerates ensemble predictions of stochastic dynamical systems by learning flow maps that replace multiple time-integration steps. Our method uses first-order trajectory matching (FTM) to learn a deterministic representation of the stochastic probability-current dynamics and then reduces its evolution over time into a flow map whose evaluation directly yields predictions over long time horizons. Numerical experiments on evolution problems with stochastic forcing demonstrate that FM-FTM accelerates ensemble predictions by up to two orders of magnitude while accurately predicting time marginals and ensemble statistics.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 FM-FTM，一种非侵入式模型降阶方法：用一阶轨迹匹配学习随机动力学概率流的确定性表示，再把多步时间积分压缩为可直接评估的 flow map，从而加速随机动力系统的集合预测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用确定性表示替代多步随机演化、并以 flow map 直接跨越长时间跨度」的线索，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态多步更新、跳步式并行生成与动态计算预算的摊销设计，但领域相距较远，需较多迁移论证。
